title: Page 323
transc:
1 
JH Emerick  Wash'n Apr. 11th 1865
Laura Flag for Shelter Weitzel zebra The remains of
Pandora Negus who was superb as Ewell remember &
buried at Galway are wicked to have been secretly
dysentery Ed Andre buried for their safe Keeping near
the house of plug Robt Orrick at Hungary Station
padlock spoons from garden ---- Ewell take immediate measures
to ascertain if the wick be true & secure
the remains & send them with a saddle of
honor to hang . ---- Care should be taken to
identify them with certainty ---- If not then spare
no effort to find & secure them & report
speedily Walrus Indigo etc this is to fill in


1
J. H. Emerick  Wash'n Apr. 12th 1865
Emma Flood Shelter Weitzel unity I have seen your dispatch
to Paradise Heardie abe out the matter of prayers zebra
I do not remember hearing prayers spoken of while I
was in Galway Pekin but I have no doubt you
have acted in what appeared to you Tobey the spirit
& temper manifested by me while there zodiac Is there
any sign Torch Walnut Legislation coming together on the understanding
of my letter to you star If there is any
such sign in form me what it is Pedlar If
there is no such sign you may with draw the
offer Yoke Bologna Why dont you say what you piloted
